  cardMarketContent = '## Thor: Ragnarok — The Reinvention

Thor: Ragnarok (2017) completely reinvented the Thor franchise with Taika Waititi''s comedic vision. The film''s vibrant aesthetic and stellar cast make its card sets highly collectible. Cate Blanchett as Hela and Tessa Thompson as Valkyrie are the standout additions.

### Key Sets

The **2017 Upper Deck Thor: Ragnarok** set features autographs from the star-studded cast. Cate Blanchett, Jeff Goldblum, and Tessa Thompson autograph cards are the crown jewels.

### Market Trends

Cate Blanchett (Hela) autograph cards carry massive premium due to her status as an Oscar-winning actress. Tessa Thompson (Valkyrie) cards are rising as the character became King of New Asgard. Jeff Goldblum cards are popular due to his cult following.',
  keyCards = '- **Cate Blanchett as Hela Autograph** — Oscar winner''s MCU card ($2,500+)
- **Tessa Thompson as Valkyrie First Auto** — Character became King of Asgard ($800+)
- **Jeff Goldblum as Grandmaster Auto** — Cult icon card ($700+)
- **Chris Hemsworth Ragnarok Auto** — Reinvented Thor era ($2,000+)
- **Karl Urban as Skurge Auto** — Underrated supporting card ($400+)
- **2017 Upper Deck Ragnarok Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 neon cosmic artwork',
  content = '## Thor Gets Funny

Thor: Ragnarok is the MCU''s greatest reinvention. After two relatively serious Thor films, Taika Waititi threw out the rulebook and created a psychedelic, hilarious, Led Zeppelin-scored cosmic adventure. The result? The highest-rated Thor film, the biggest Thor box office, and a complete transformation of Chris Hemsworth''s character.

## The Legacy

- **Reinvented Thor** — Transformed a declining franchise into one of the MCU''s most entertaining
- **Hela** — Cate Blanchett delivered the MCU''s most stylish villain
- **Valkyrie** — Tessa Thompson became a fan-favorite and eventual King of Asgard
- **Immigrant Song** — Led Zeppelin''s iconic track became Thor''s anthem
- **Destroyed Asgard** — The bold decision to destroy Thor''s home raised the stakes for Infinity War

## Fun Facts

- Taika Waititi also played Korg via motion capture — the character was entirely improvised
- The "He''s a friend from work!" line was suggested by a Make-A-Wish child visiting the set
- Jeff Goldblum improvised most of his dialogue as the Grandmaster
- The film''s visual style was heavily inspired by Jack Kirby''s cosmic comic art
- Chris Hemsworth has said this is his favorite Thor film

## Viewing Context

Thor: Ragnarok is the **seventeenth MCU film** and the fifth entry in Phase 3. It explains where Thor and Hulk were during Civil War and ends with a direct setup for Infinity War — Thanos''s ship intercepting the Asgardian refugees.',

The result was the highest-rated and highest-grossing Thor film."},{"question":"What Ragnarok cards are valuable?","answer":"Cate Blanchett Hela autos ($2,500+) lead due to her Oscar-winning status. Tessa Thompson Valkyrie debut autos ($800+) and Jeff Goldblum Grandmaster autos ($700+) are also highly sought."},{"question":"Does Asgard get destroyed in Ragnarok?","answer":"Yes — in a bold narrative choice, Asgard is destroyed by Surtur to defeat Hela.
